title: Implement canonical markdown rendering for ShoppingListDocument
description: Implement `renderMarkdown()` so structured documents serialize into the canonical markdown form defined by the spec, including title, notes, meals, aisles, blank-line normalization, and single trailing newline behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Rendering order is `Title -> Notes -> Meals -> Aisles` with canonical blank-line handling.
Aisle names are written exactly as stored and checklist items render with canonical `- [ ]` / `- [x]` formatting.
Rendered output is suitable for parse-render fixed-point tests and file I/O boundaries.

handoff_summary.design_decisions:
renderMarkdown() uses a parts-accumulator pattern joined by 

, guaranteeing exactly one blank line between every section. Empty-document path returns "
" (a single newline), which is itself a fixed point under parse→render. Empty aisles (no items) render as a bare ## heading with no item lines, consistent with the spec's retained-aisle-on-removeItem contract.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written in this bead (tester responsibility). Fixed-point property should be tested with: (1) empty document, (2) title-only, (3) full real-world fixture, (4) document with HTML-comment notes block, (5) ## Other aisle, (6) aisle with no items.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The parser (init(markdown:)) can only produce at most one Block in notes (all pre-section content is flushed once). The renderer correctly handles multiple blocks but the parser never generates more than one. This is an inherent limitation of the single-pass design, not a bug.
